description: This PHP class subscribes to employee save events within the OrangeHRM system and triggers processing of registration-related events for active and inactive employee counts.

classes.name: RegistrationEventPersistSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for EmployeeSaved events and triggers registration event processing for active and inactive employee counts.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the EmployeeSaved event to the handler method 'onEmployeeSaved'.

methods.name: onEmployeeSaved
methods.description: Handles the employee saved event by creating processors for active and inactive employee counts and saving registration events.
